experiment_data.hypothesis: Base→chat model pairs from v1 leaderboard exhibit benchmark-specific Δlz* anomalies: instruction-tuning produces a consistent cross-benchmark Δlz* shift, but contamination on specific benchmarks manifests as outlier Δlz* on those benchmarks relative to the pair's mean Δlz* across benchmarks

spec.data_path: v1 leaderboard MMLU/HellaSwag/ARC-C/GSM8K per-item responses + PSN-IRT params
spec.data_count: 21 base-chat pairs x 4 benchmarks = 61 pair-benchmark combinations
spec.eval_data: v1 leaderboard per-item responses for 21 base-chat model pairs

HellaSwag.interpretation: SFT systematically decreases person-fit on HellaSwag

GSM8K.interpretation: SFT systematically increases person-fit on GSM8K

metrics.key_finding: HellaSwag and GSM8K show significant systematic SFT effects on lz*, but no individual pair shows benchmark-specific contamination outliers. P2-optional per Director assessment.
